cues.text: Here is the model essay: design edge networking for predictive maintenance and evaluate cloud alternatives.
Start by explaining why near-source real-time processing reduces WAN delay and supports continuity.
Draw the segmented device, edge, industrial DMZ and cloud architecture.
Keep safety control local, explain anomaly processing and alert-only transfer.
Quantify the raw and filtered traffic rates, retention requirements and percentage reduction using stated assumptions.
Discuss security, privacy, resilience, model accuracy, patching and costs.
Compare cloud-only centralised compute with its WAN dependency, and edge with its distributed management overhead.
SDN, NFV and MEC may support a deployment, but not every plant needs all of them.
Test local operation, recovery, data integrity and actual bandwidth before claiming benefit.
Your essay should connect every technology choice to an operational requirement.
